RADIO LOG -- WATER (CASES) -- 15 NOV

0600 DEPOT: start of day, depot holding 500 cases.
0700 DEPOT: two trucks out. Truck 1 to Base Alpha with 120. Truck 2 to Bravo carrying 90.
0930 BASE_A: Alpha here, truck 1 in, 120 received. We're at 160 on hand.
0950 BASE_B: got the 90 from the depot. Bravo count is 130.
1200 BASE_A: pushed cases forward to the posts -- POST_1 and POST_2 got 100 between them.
1400 POST_1: have 60 on hand.
1430 POST_2: 40 on the ground here.
1600 DEPOT: CORRECTION to 0700 -- truck 1 actually left with 125, not 120. Manifest count error.
1700 BASE_B: sent 20 cases back to DEPOT, those were the wrong lot.
